meta.title: [SymbolReader] Make symbol server timeout configurable and remove dead server mechanism
meta.body_summary: Add configurable symbol server timeout (TimeSpan) and remove dead server blocking to improve symbol resolution in slow network environments.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added configurable timeout and removed dead server blocking; brianrob requested API type change to TimeSpan which was fixed before merge; merged with praise.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 45 changed lines, this is a very small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small, fast‑turnaround performance PR and is consistent with the successful, low‑friction merge after a minor API design feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: brianrob requested changing `ServerTimeoutSeconds` (int) to `ServerTimeout` (TimeSpan) for better semantics and .NET consistency.
review_details.performance_claim: Configurable timeout prevents long waits and dead server removal improves symbol resolution on subsequent attempts, enhancing PerfView behavior on slow networks.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Small, self‑contained public API addition in a .NET library; Agent successfully understood and implemented the change with one round of API surface feedback.

detection_detail.code_reading: brianrob reviewed the inline diff and requested a change from `int ServerTimeoutSeconds` to `TimeSpan ServerTimeout`.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after timing data; performance claim relies on allowing network timeout configuration and removing dead‑server blocking.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After review, Copilot immediately updated property type in commit c7f656e.

core_change_summary.description: Added configurable `ServerTimeout` property (TimeSpan) to SymbolReader, removed the dead server list and 5‑minute blocking mechanism, and updated log messages. All changes in SymbolReader.cs.
